scripts.setup: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv sync --project backend && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.dev:api: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend uvicorn --factory app.api:create_app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.start: pnpm build && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend python -m app.main
scripts.test: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml && pnpm --filter @chatty/server test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @chatty/frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter @chatty/server typecheck && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend ty check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:server && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm format:check
scripts.lint:backend: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend ruff check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @chatty/frontend format && pnpm --filter @chatty/server format && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend ruff format backend/app backend/tests
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @chatty/frontend exec prettier --check . && UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend/app backend/tests
scripts.eval:retrieval: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend python -m app.evals.retrieval
scripts.eval:agent: UV_CACHE_DIR=.cache/uv uv run --project backend python -m app.evals.agent
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
